title: Coffee shop queue
summary: Customers arrive at random at a coffee shop with one till. See how long they wait, and why a till that is busy only 75% of the time still keeps them in line.
origin: Written for this project: spec 1's example model (examples/coffee_shop.json), with answers from the M/M/1 queue, Little's law and Erlang C (docs/research/spec-4-template-sources.md).
